Article 3

Dans la partie III de la partie réglementaire du même Code, il est inséré un titre II/1 comportant les articles R.40.2 à R.40.25, rédigé comme suit :

" Titre II/1. - Reconnaissance et subventionnement structurel des associations environnementales

CHAPITRE Ier. - Dispositions générales

Art. R.40.2.

Au sens du présent chapitre, on entend par :

  1. administration : les services désignés par le Ministre ayant l'Environnement dans ses attributions;
  2. Ministre concerné : le Ministre qui a dans ses attributions une des thématiques environnementales pour laquelle une demande de subventionnement est introduite par l'association.

CHAPITRE II. - Reconnaissance des associations en tant qu'associations environnementales

Section 1re. - Procédure de reconnaissance des associations
Art. R.40.3.

§ 1er.

La demande de reconnaissance ou la demande de reconnaissance conjointe est introduite au moyen du formulaire déterminé par le Ministre de l'Environnement.

§ 2.

L'administration envoie sa décision statuant sur le caractère complet et recevable de la demande à l'association demanderesse ou aux associations ayant introduit une demande de reconnaissance conjointe dans un délai de trente jours à dater du jour qui suit celui de la réception de la demande.

La demande est incomplète s'il manque les éléments définis aux articles R.40.6 à R.40.9.

Lorsque la demande est déclarée incomplète, l'administration envoie aux demandeurs la liste des éléments manquants et précise le délai endéans lequel les documents manquants lui sont transmis, et ce, au maximum dans un délai de vingt jours à dater de l'envoi de la liste des éléments manquants.

Si le ou les demandeurs n'ont pas envoyé les éléments demandés dans le délai imparti, la demande est déclarée irrecevable.

Dans les trente jours à dater de la réception des éléments manquants, l'administration envoie sa décision statuant sur le caractère complet et recevable de la demande à l'association demanderesse ou aux associations ayant introduit une demande de reconnaissance conjointe.

§ 3.

Un rapport est rédigé par l'administration et transmis au Gouvernement au plus tard dans un délai de nonante jours à dater du jour qui suit la date de l'envoi de la décision attestant du caractère complet et recevable de la demande. Le rapport comporte l'avis de l'administration sur la satisfaction des conditions visées aux articles D.28-5 à D.28.8 accompagné d'un projet de décision.

§ 4.

Le Gouvernement envoie sa décision à l'association demanderesse ou aux associations ayant introduit une demande de reconnaissance conjointe dans un délai de cent-trente-cinq jours à dater du jour qui suit la date de l'envoi de la décision attestant du caractère complet et recevable de la demande.

§ 5.

Si la décision n'est pas envoyée à l'association dans le délai prévu au paragraphe 4, la reconnaissance est réputée refusée.

Art. R.40.4.

La reconnaissance est accordée à partir du 1er janvier qui suit la date de notification.

Art. R.40.5.

Au plus tard le 31 mars de la dernière année de reconnaissance, l'association introduit une demande de renouvellement à l'administration via le guichet unique visé à l'article D.28-10. La demande de renouvellement comprend une actualisation des éléments visés aux articles R.40.6 à R.40.9. La procédure de renouvellement est celle prévue à l'article R.40-3.

Section 2. - Contenu minimal de la demande de reconnaissance
Art. R.40.6.

La demande de reconnaissance ou la demande de reconnaissance conjointe visée à l'article D.28-9 comprend au minimum les éléments suivants pour chacune des associations demanderesses :

  1. l'identification de la catégorie pour laquelle la demande de reconnaissance est introduite;
  2. l'adresse du centre d'opération, et les coordonnées de l'association;
  3. un bilan financier comprenant un tableau récapitulatif des recettes et des dépenses par poste des deux exercices civils précédents la demande de reconnaissance approuvés par les organes décisionnels de l'association;
  4. une note présentant son objet principal et précisant les activités réalisées les trois dernières années d'activités et décrivant la manière dont l'association répond aux prescrits de l'article D 28.5, 1°, 2° et 4°;
  5. une déclaration sur l'honneur attestant du respect de de l'article D.28-5, 3°;
  6. le numéro de la police d'assurance en responsabilité civile couvrant l'ensemble des dommages pouvant résulter de son activité, de celui de son personnel ou de ses bénévoles.
Art. R.40.7.

Pour être reconnue en tant que " Fédération ou Réseau ", la demande de reconnaissance ou la demande de reconnaissance conjointe visée à l'article D.28.9 comprend les éléments complémentaires suivants :

  1. la liste de ses associations membres ainsi que les conditions à remplir pour devenir membre;
  2. la liste des services que l'association offre à ses membres;
  3. un compte-rendu exhaustif des actions organisées lors des deux exercices civils précédents la demande tendant à la protection de l'environnement, à l'amélioration de l'état de l'environnement, à l'éducation à l'environnement et à la sensibilisation à l'environnement ouvertes à ses membres ou au public comprenant au minimum trente actions par an ainsi que de leur portée;
  4. la liste des instances dans lesquelles elle représente ses membres.
Art. R.40.8.

Pour être reconnue en tant qu'" Association régionale ", la demande de reconnaissance visée à l'article D.28.9 comprend l'élément complémentaire suivant : un compte-rendu exhaustif des actions organisées lors des deux exercices civils précédents la demande pour ses membres ou le public comprenant au minimum 20 actions par an ainsi que de leur portée.

Art. R.40.9.

Pour être reconnue en tant qu'" Association locale ", la demande de reconnaissance ou la demande de reconnaissance conjointe visée à l'article D.28.9 comprend les éléments complémentaires suivants :

  1. un compte-rendu exhaustif des actions organisées lors des deux exercices civils précédents la demande pour ses membres ou le public et comportant au minimum 5 actions par an ainsi que de leur portée;
  2. une liste des communes sur lesquelles elle exerce ses activités.

CHAPITRE III. - Subventionnement structurel des associations reconnues en tant qu'associations environnementales

Section 1re. - Procédure d'octroi et de refus du subventionnement
Art. R.40.10.

§ 1er.

La demande est introduite dans le courant du premier trimestre de l'année civile qui précède l'année de subventionnement au moyen du formulaire déterminé par le Ministre.

§ 2.

L'administration envoie à l'association demanderesse sa décision statuant sur le caractère complet et recevable de la demande dans un délai de trente jours à dater du jour qui suit celui de la réception de la demande.

La demande est déclarée incomplète s'il manque les renseignements ou documents requis en vertu de l'article R.40.12.

Lorsque la demande est déclarée incomplète, l'administration envoie au demandeur la liste des éléments manquants et précise le délai endéans lequel les documents manquants lui sont transmis, et ce, au maximum dans un délai de vingt jours à dater de l'envoi de la liste des éléments manquants.

Si le demandeur n'a pas envoyé les éléments demandés dans le délai imparti, la demande est déclarée irrecevable.

Dans les trente jours à dater de la réception des éléments manquants, l'administration envoie sa décision statuant sur le caractère complet et recevable de la demande à l'association demanderesse.

§ 3.

Un rapport relatif au subventionnement est rédigé par l'administration et transmis aux Ministres concernés par la demande au plus tard dans un délai de nonante jours à dater du jour qui suit la décision attestant du caractère complet et recevable de la demande. Le rapport comporte l'avis de l'administration fondé sur les critères définis à l'article D.28.11 accompagné d'un projet de décision.

§ 4.

Chaque Ministre concerné notifie son avis au Ministre de l'Environnement for the part of the requested funding related to an environmental theme within their jurisdiction. The Minister of the Environment sends the decision on the funding request to the requesting association within one hundred and thirty-five days from the day following the decision confirming the completeness and admissibility of the request. The Minister of the Environment is bound by the opinions provided by the concerned Ministers for the part of the funding related to environmental themes under their competence. The opinions and the decision referred to in the first paragraph are motivated with regard to the criteria referred to in Article D.28-11.

§ 5.

In the absence of sending the decision within the time limit provided for in paragraph 4, the requesting association may send a reminder letter to the Minister of the Environment by means of a method allowing to give a certain date to the sending and receipt of the act, regardless of the mail distribution service used. In the absence of sending a decision within thirty days from the receipt of the reminder letter, the funding is deemed refused.

§ 6.

The reminder letter contains the following mentions:

  1. the name and address of the applicant;
  2. the file references;
  3. the term "reminder".
Art. R.40.11.

The grant is awarded for 3 years from January 1 following the notification of the decision within the limits of budgetary credits.

Section 2. - Minimum content of the funding request
Art. R.40.12.

The grant application includes:

  1. an environmental action plan or a coordinated environmental action plan including at least the following elements:
    1. the general and operational objectives that the association sets for the duration of the funding and how these fit into the regional sustainable development strategy;
    2. the environmental themes for which funding is requested;
    3. the identification of the target audience for the activities presented in the environmental action plan;
    4. the strategies and methodologies that the association intends to implement to achieve the set objectives;
    5. the three-year activity program accompanied by an argument regarding the relevance of the action project in reference to the audiences it targets and the environmental, territorial, social, socio-cultural, and, where applicable, economic context in which it develops its project;
    6. the description and allocation of logistical, human, and financial resources necessary to achieve the objectives set by the activity program;
    7. where applicable, an evaluation report of the expired environmental action plan previously carried out;
    8. result indicators;
  2. the amount of the requested grant broken down between the different environmental themes.
Section 3. - Funding criteria
Art. R.40.13.

Within the limits of budgetary credits, a three-year flat-rate grant is awarded from January 1 of the calendar year following the submission of the funding request to each environmental association based on its environmental action plan. The flat-rate amount of the grant constitutes the sum of the flat-rate personnel expenses allocated to the missions accepted in the environmental action plan as set out in Article R.40.14 as well as the related flat-rate operating expenses as set out in Article R.40-15, which may not exceed 25% of eligible personnel expenses.

Art. R.40.14.

Flat-rate expenses may not exceed the amounts set based on the Walloon Region salary scale relating to Joint Commission 329.02. Flat-rate personnel expenses cover a maximum of:

  1. the gross salary of the personnel;
  2. employer social security contributions, as well as contributions related to vacation pay, year-end bonuses, other miscellaneous expenses, and other legal and conventional obligations related to personnel and social secretariat fees.
Art. R.40.15.

Flat-rate operating expenses are taken into account when they allow the association to cover the current expenses necessary for the accomplishment of its missions, including:

  1. travel expenses if the purpose of the trip is clearly specified;
  2. expenses related to telephone and Internet connections and consumption;
  3. office expenses related to the realization of activities;
  4. the purchase of equipment if its use is related to the exercise of the missions contained in the environmental action plan;
  5. rental expenses for buildings or parts of buildings, including related rental charges if they result from a duly executed lease contract;
  6. registration fees for conferences or training sessions;
  7. fees if the purpose, date, and periodicity of the intended service are clearly identified;
  8. communication, printing, and dissemination costs of the information document.

For the application of paragraph 1, 5°, if the building is used for activities other than those financed by the grant, the charges are allocated either based on the time of use for the financed activity or based on the surface area required for it.

Art. R.40.16.

In addition to the operating expenses referred to in Article R. 40.15, the depreciation of patrimonial assets with an estimated useful life of more than one year is admitted for the benefit of the grant as operating expenses and calculated according to the following rules:

  1. ten years for furniture;
  2. five years for office equipment;
  3. three years for computer software.

CHAPITRE IV. - Contrôle et évaluation

Section 1re. - Contrôle
Art. R. 40.17.

The administration may control compliance with the recognition conditions referred to in Articles D.28.5 to D.28.7 by the environmental association.

Art. R. 40.18.

§ 1er.

The association transmits to the administration, via the single window referred to in Article D.28-10, no later than February 15 of years N+1 and N+2, an activity report accompanied by a claim declaration and a summary table of income and expenses by budget item justifying the use of the elapsed tranche.

§ 2.

The annual activity report referred to in paragraph 1 consists of three parts:

  1. the first part relates to the identification of the association;
  2. the second part relates to the activities carried out during the year in question;
  3. the third part relates to the themes addressed by the association as well as the achievement of the objectives determined in the environmental action plan.

The activity report takes the form of the electronic form determined by the Minister to which are attached the claim declaration and a summary table of income and expenses by budget item. The form is completed and transmitted to the administration via the single window referred to in Article D.28.10.

In cases where the Minister of the Environment or his delegate considers that the administration can obtain directly, from authentic sources within the meaning of Article 2, 1° of the cooperation agreement of May 23, 2013, between the Walloon Region and the French Community concerning the development of a joint initiative on data sharing and the joint management of this initiative, certain data necessary for the establishment of the activity report, he exempts the applicant from transmitting them to the administration.

Art. R.40.19.

§ 1er.

The association transmits to the administration, via the Single Window, no later than March 31 of the year following the end of the grant, a general implementation report of the environmental action plan or the coordinated environmental action plan accompanied by a claim declaration and a summary table of income and expenses by item for the entire period of the environmental action plan or the coordinated environmental action plan.

§ 2.

The general implementation report referred to in paragraph 1 consists of six parts:

  1. the first part relates to the identification of the association;
  2. the second part relates to a presentation of the emblematic activities carried out by the association;
  3. the third part relates to the self-assessment of the results of the environmental association with regard to the general and operational objectives and the indicators it had set for the implementation of the environmental action plan;
  4. the fourth part relates to the recipients of the association's services or target audiences;
  5. the fifth part relates to the association's development prospects;
  6. the sixth part relates to the integration into the regional sustainable development strategy.

It takes the form of the electronic form determined by the administration. It is completed and transmitted to the administration via the Single Window.

In cases where the Minister of the Environment or his delegate considers that the administration can obtain directly, from authentic sources within the meaning of Article 2, 1°, of the cooperation agreement of May 23, 2013, between the Walloon Region and the French Community concerning the development of a joint initiative on data sharing and the joint management of this initiative, certain data necessary for the establishment of the activity report, he exempts the applicant from transmitting them to the administration.

§ 3.

The administration transmits to the Walloon Institute for Evaluation, Foresight, and Statistics all the data necessary for their missions set out in Article D.28-17.

Section 2. - Suspension and withdrawal of recognition and grant
Art. R.40.20.

§ 1er.

When the administration finds that an association does not or no longer meets the conditions for granting recognition or funding, it sends a warning indicating the deadline within which it is required to meet the conditions for granting recognition or funding and its decision, if applicable, to suspend the granting of the grant during the period. The suspension of the granting of grants can only be carried out after giving the association the opportunity to present its means of defense.

§ 2.

If at the end of the deadline the association does not meet the conditions for granting recognition or funding, the administration informs the association of the possibility of withdrawing recognition or funding. The administration specifies:

  1. the reasons justifying the proposed measure;
  2. the means available to the association to present in writing its means of defense, within twenty days from the day of receipt of this information, and that it has, on this occasion, the right to request the administration to present its oral defense.

The administration transmits to the Government a proposal for a decision on the withdrawal within thirty days from the expiration of the deadline referred to in paragraph 2, first paragraph, 2°, or from the date of the hearing. The day the administration sends the proposal to the Government, it notifies the association.

Within forty-five days of receiving the administration's proposal for a decision, the Government sends its decision to the association.

In the absence of sending the decision by the Government within the time limit provided for in paragraph 3, it is deemed to conform to the administration's proposal for a decision if it was sent within the time limit provided for in paragraph 2 to the Government. The administration sends the association the proposal for a decision referred to in paragraph 2.

In the absence of sending the decision by the Government within the time limit provided for in paragraph 3 and if the administration's proposal for a decision was not sent within the time limit provided for in paragraph 2, the first instance decision is deemed confirmed.

CHAPITRE V. - Recours

Art. R. 40.21.

§ 1er.

In the event of refusal of recognition, total or partial refusal of funding, total or partial withdrawal of funding, withdrawal of recognition, an appeal is open to the requesting association before the Government. Under penalty of inadmissibility, the appeal is submitted within 30 days from the day following that of

  1. receipt of the decision referred to in Article R.40-3, § 5, in Article R.40-10, § 4, and in Article R.40-20, § 2, third paragraph;
  2. receipt of the decision sent within thirty days from the reminder letter provided for in Article R.40-10, § 5;
  3. receipt of the administration's proposal for a decision referred to in Article R.40-20, § 2, fourth paragraph;
  4. expiration of the deadline for sending the decision provided for in Article R.40-3, § 4, in Article R.40-10, § 5, second paragraph, and in Article R.40-20, § 2, fifth paragraph.

The appeal is sent to the headquarters of the support committee as defined by the Minister of the Environment. It specifies the elements on which the association relies to contest the decision and whether the association wishes to be heard.

§ 2.

The support committee transmits, where applicable after hearing the requesting association, within sixty days from the receipt of the appeal, an opinion report to the Government. The Government sends its decision within forty-five days from the receipt of the support committee's opinion report or from the expiration of the time limit for the support committee to transmit its proposal for a decision. The forty-five-day period is suspended between July 15 and August 31 inclusive.

In the absence of sending the decision within the time limit referred to in the first paragraph, the decision subject to the appeal is confirmed.

CHAPITRE VI. - Comité d'accompagnement

Art. R.40.22.

The public call for applications referred to in Article D.28-17, § 4, is published by the administration in the Belgian Monitor.

The public call for applications specifies the following elements:

  1. the title and purpose of the mandate(s);
  2. the incompatibilities;
  3. the content of the application act for it to be considered complete;
  4. the address to which the application act is transmitted;
  5. the deadline within which the application act is sent to be admissible.

CHAPITRE VII. - Dispositions transitoires et finales

Art. R.40.23.

Unless otherwise provided, the sending is done:

  1. either by registered letter to the post office with acknowledgment of receipt;
  2. or by using any similar formula allowing to give a certain date to the sending and receipt of the act, regardless of the mail distribution service used;
  3. or by filing an act against receipt;
  4. or by using electronic registered mail procedures allowing to obtain proof of sending and the time of sending as well as proof of the sender's identity.
Art. R.40-24.

§ 1er.

Pending the establishment of the single window referred to in Article D.28.10, recognition and funding requests from environmental associations as well as activity reports and general implementation reports of environmental action plans are submitted to the following address: DGO3 (Development Department), chaussée de Louvain 14, 5000 Namur.

The requesting association submits its file in two formats, on the one hand, in paper format and on the other hand in electronic form via email or any digital means defined by the administration.

§ 2.

Pending the establishment of the single window, the ninety-day deadlines mentioned in Article R.40.3, § 3, and in Article R.40.10, § 3, are extended to one hundred and fifty days. The one hundred and thirty-five-day deadlines referred to in Articles R.40.3, § 4, and R.40.10, § 4, are extended to one hundred and eighty days.

Art. R.40.25.

The single window will be operational no later than January 1, 2017.
